# Master Commercial Cleaning

> Commercial and janitorial cleaning for businesses in Winnipeg, Selkirk, Oakbank, and Beausejour, Manitoba.

Master Commercial Cleaning Services & Building Maintenance Ltd. cleans offices, retail, medical, dental, and other commercial facilities. The company has operated since 2015 and is bonded and insured.

- Website: https://mastercleaning.ca/
- Phone: +1-204-698-1133
- Email: clean@mastercleaning.ca
- Office: Unit 7, 1599 Dugald Rd, Winnipeg, MB R2J 0H3, Canada
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Closed Sunday.
- Service area: Winnipeg, Selkirk, Oakbank, Beausejour, and part of Manitoba

## Services

- [Commercial cleaning services](https://mastercleaning.ca/services.html): overview of janitorial and specialty cleaning
- [Janitorial and office cleaning](https://mastercleaning.ca/janitorial-cleaning.html): scheduled cleaning for offices and business properties
- [Carpet and upholstery cleaning](https://mastercleaning.ca/carpet-upholstery-cleaning.html): hot-water extraction for commercial carpets and upholstery
- [Floor care](https://mastercleaning.ca/floor-care.html): stripping, waxing, and polishing
- [Window cleaning](https://mastercleaning.ca/window-cleaning.html): interior and exterior commercial windows
- [Post-construction cleaning](https://mastercleaning.ca/post-construction-cleaning.html): cleanup after renovation and new construction
- [Pressure washing](https://mastercleaning.ca/pressure-washing.html): walkways, entrances, and building exteriors
- [Medical and dental office cleaning](https://mastercleaning.ca/medical-dental-cleaning.html): clinic cleaning with attention to high-touch surfaces
- [Drive-thru and exterior detailing](https://mastercleaning.ca/drive-thru-exterior-detailing.html): parking lots, drive-thru lanes, entrances, and dumpster areas
- [Industries](https://mastercleaning.ca/industries.html): retail, offices, medical, schools, restaurants, and other facilities
